items.evidence: roll.py --headless --board 3 --script clear3.txt (my feedback-controller script): tick 668 board 3 score 20; tick 669 board 4, texts 'Board 4 of 4', ball (-3,1.25,0), coins (-2,0.25,0),(2.2,1.2,0),(3.5,0.25,1.5), sounds ...coin,clear; screen not won. World has one slab (-4..4,-0.2..0,-2..2) and one ramp box. --board 4 accepted, --board 5 rejected.

--board 4 with 0:right: y>0.5 with -1<x<1 from tick 78 (x=-0.37,y=0.52); x>1 and y>0.6 at tick 105 (x=1.03,y=0.97) and later. Ball centre's distance to the brief's ramp box never below 0.246 (r=0.25) over runs pushing into it from +z, -z, from +x under the high edge (stopped at x=1.066), up it and resting on it (y=0.69 at x=0.21).

--board 4 script clear4.txt (0:right,106:none, then PD to last coin): air coin taken at tick ~122 with ball at x~1.9-2.0, y~0.8-0.9 (past the ramp end, off any surface); tick 237 screen won, score 30, lives 3. The 3->4 run (clear3.txt) also ends won, score 60, no lives lost.
--board 1..4 in en/es/fr: 'Board N of 4', 'Tablero N de 4', 'Plateau N sur 4' for every N; the 3->4 transition also shows 'Board 4 of 4'.

Language menu_right cycles en->es->fr->en; menu_left from en gives fr. With fr saved: title 'Roll, Démarrer, Réglages, Quitter, Haut / Bas pour bouger...', settings 'Réglages, Volume : 8, Langue : Français, Balle : Normale, Retour, Gauche / Droite...', play 'Plateau 1 sur 4, Score : 0, Vies : 3', paused 'En pause, Reprendre, Retour au titre', won 'Vous avez gagné...Appuyez sur Entrée...', lost 'Partie terminée'; language=fr. Frames show the same.

Settings items Volume, Language, Ball, Back (menu_down x3 selects Back). Ball starts Normal; right -> Heavy (clamped on further rights), left -> Light, right,left -> Normal; ball_kind follows; texts 'Ball: Heavy' / 'Bola: Normal' / 'Balle : Normale'.

Board 2, scripts 0:right / 0:right,70:none / 0:right,40:none for light/normal/heavy: ball x identical before the strike (e.g. -0.50838 at tick 74 for all three with 0:right). Sum of six crate displacements 120 ticks after strike: light 0.44/0.25/0.05, normal 1.86/1.18/0.14, heavy 10.0/4.17/0.74.

Run setting volume 5, fr, heavy wrote {volume:5,language:fr,ball:heavy}; next run with the same folder starts fr/5/heavy (also on --board 2). Old file {volume:3,language:es} loads es/3 with ball_kind normal.

Rechecked m01-m12, m14-m24 on the changed game: all hold (m08 first contact tick 27, rests y=0.2495, 4 bounces; m10 +10 per coin, board 2 after 4th coin with 6 crates; m11 max drift 0.005; m12 2 crates moved >0.3, ball never reaches x=1 in 300 ticks; m15 bridge 1,2,1,0; m16 offset to bridge within -0.60..-0.49 over 180 ticks, gap fall at tick 254; m17 board 3 cleared with score 30 then board 4, won screen frozen until enter; m18/m19 freeze; m20 identical outputs; WAVs 0.29/0.16/0.85/0.88 s, distinct, non-silent). m13 failed before, not held.

--board 4 --ticks 60 --frame: 800x480 PNG showing the checkered slab, a purple tilted slab (thicker high edge at +x), the ball at left, and the three coins (one drawn high beyond the ramp); after the -2 coin is taken it is gone from the frame.
CHANGES.md lists each change with files/functions (BOARDS[4], ramps, Body.hs, TEXT['fr'], font, ball setting), how it was checked, and faults found before.

defects: Without a settings folder the game would write saved/settings.json inside the game folder when a setting changes (default folder is next to roll.py) - by design, noted only.
On board 4 a held right push from the start carries the ball off the far edge (falls) after taking the air coin; the push must be released to stay on the board - not a brief requirement.
French 'Volume' and 'Score' are the same spelling as English; they are correct French words.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
